title: Forest of Remembrance
visualBrief: Madrid’s Forest of Remembrance memorial mound with its north causeway, rising spiral, summit loop, granite-lined crescent channel, three timber bridges and fluted entrance column. The 170 cypresses and 22 olives follow the original planting inventory, with recorded tree points and inferred infill.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: OpenStreetMap memorial way 243095305 and the standard PMTiles extract identify the exact park parcel, moat, spiral, three bridge traces and column. The north causeway and bridge endpoints fix the east/up/south frame.
sourceFacts.landscapeHeights: Meter scale from current PMTiles. The ground model follows Terrarium outside the planted hill and rises along the mapped spiral to its summit loop.

materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.

limitations: The summit rises approximately 5.75 m above the entrance path in the model. Terraces, current tree heights, individual species assignment and unmapped planting positions are photo-led.
The plaque is represented by its dark face. Inscription text and park furniture outside the memorial parcel remain outside the modeled scope.
importReason: Preserve the individually modeled planting, bank faces, path grades and timber bridge rails.
